environment.description: Service binary executed under a pivot_root(2) confinement established by the container entrypoint script prior to dropping privileges. The entrypoint performs: (1) creates a minimal tmpfs at /srv/jail containing only /var/app/uploads, /var/app/extracted, and /tmp with mode 1777; (2) bind-mounts the compiled binary read-only at /srv/jail/app; (3) calls pivot_root('/srv/jail', '/srv/jail/.pivot_old') then unmounts and rmdir .pivot_old making the old root inaccessible; (4) drops to uid=65534(nobody) with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS and a seccomp-bpf filter allowing only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, munmap, brk, futex, epoll_ctl, epoll_pwait, accept4, clone, sigaltstack, gettid, sched_yield, nanosleep, exit_group, mkdirat (restricted to relative paths under CWD). The openat filter argument-checks that dirfd is either AT_FDCWD or a descriptor obtained from within the jail, and rejects any path component matching '..'. The net effect: even if zip-slip traversal resolves to ../../etc/passwd, the kernel returns ENOENT because no such path exists within the pivoted root namespace, and the seccomp filter independently blocks openat calls with '..' in the pathname argument.

config.seccomp_bpf: allowlist with openat path-argument filter rejecting '..' components
